description: Unique identifier for the widget tile. Must be unique across all rows.
Component type to render. Determines which visualisation is shown.
allowed_values: sheldon-chart-bars, sheldon-chart-h-bars, sheldon-kpi, sheldon-list, sheldon-segmented-chart, sheldon-chart-treemap, sheldon-mosaic-map, sheldon-card-descrizione

description: Title shown in the widget header.
Key of the dataset to display. Must match a key field in dashboardParsingConfig.
allowed_values: interventiPerComune, interventiPerFine, interventiPerInizio, comuniConInterventi, interventiPerCategoria, interventiPerTarget, interventiPerTema, interventiPerTipologia, interventiPerFonte, interventiPerPartecipazione, interventiPerStato, interventiPerUnione, interventoRandomGarfagnana, interventoRandomLunigiana, interventoRandomSerchio, interventoRandomPistoiese, featureComuni

description: Width of the tile in grid columns. The full grid is 12 columns wide, so tileWidth=3 means the tile occupies one quarter of the row.
Field used to group and aggregate data along the chart axis.
Aggregation function applied to each group.
allowed_values: count (number of items), sum (total of valore), max (highest valore)

description: Field on which the global filter is applied to this widget. Leave empty for no filter.
used_by: sheldon-chart-bars, sheldon-chart-h-bars, sheldon-kpi, sheldon-list, sheldon-segmented-chart, sheldon-chart-treemap

description: When this field changes in the global filter it resets all other active filters. Usually the same as filterBy.
used_by: sheldon-chart-bars, sheldon-chart-h-bars, sheldon-kpi, sheldon-list, sheldon-segmented-chart, sheldon-chart-treemap

description: Axis along which results are sorted.
allowed_values: category (alphabetical by group label), value (by aggregated value)

description: Default direction of the sort.
Whether to display the sort toggle buttons in the widget header.
Maximum number of items shown. Use 0 for no limit (show all).
Text shown in the information overlay when the user clicks the info icon.

Additional aggregate metrics shown as toggle buttons above the chart. Each element must be a JSON object with keys: label (button text), campo (field to aggregate), reduceBy (count/sum/max). Example: [{"label":"N","campo":"comune","reduceBy":"count"},{"label":"€ TOT","campo":"valore","reduceBy":"sum"}]
Minimum font size in pixels for the large KPI numeric value. Increase for short numbers.
allowed_values: e.g. 45 (default) or 120 for very prominent KPIs

description: Unit of measure displayed after the KPI value.
Data field to aggregate on for the treemap tiles.
Fields used to colour and label treemap tiles. Must match the explodeOn / gruppi key in dashboardParsingConfig. Example: ["categoria"]
allowed_values: JSON array of field name strings, e.g. ["categoria"], ["target"], ["tema"], ["tipologia"]

description: GeoJSON feature property used to match municipalities to dataset values.
Rows shown in the map hover tooltip. Each element must have: property (GeoJSON feature property key) and label (human-readable label). Example: [{"property":"inCorso","label":"Progetti in corso"}]
Name of the field in the dataset record from which the description text is read.
Name of the field in the dataset record from which the link URL is read.
